body: The owner asked for a fix spec covering all Android findings (interphase bug pathway, with the feature method for H3, H5, H10, H11, H12 and H14), to be handed to mitosis afterwards. Fixing is outside this thread's scope; the spec lives at docs/specs/android-e2e-defect-fixes.md (git-ignored) with its decisions file beside it.U+000AU+000ARoot causes confirmed by probe on 2026-09-24:U+000AU+002D B1: VideoPlayer laid out in a SizedBox(width: aspectRatio, height: 1.0) and scaled up by FittedBox draws nothing on this phone. The same aspect ratio at 1000x the box size plays the picture through to the last frame.U+000AU+002D B2: declaring flutter_local_notifications' ScheduledNotificationReceiver and ScheduledNotificationBootReceiver made the 20:57 reminder post (channel daily_reminder).U+000AU+002D B3: Android's InputConnectionAdaptor.handleKeyEvent sends a Deletion of the selected photo's U+FFFC followed by an Insertion. The deletion alone classifies as RemovePhotoEdit (P3 takes the preceding separator for a last photo). Merging the pair into one replacement makes both draft tests pass, and all 1,293 note_engine and capture/text tests stay green.U+000AU+000ATo reproduce these probes, the plain app on the phone was cleared with Delete all (test data only) and now carries a probe build that includes the receivers.
